annotations.title: Find the fix for an accessibility problem

description: Search the Learn guides by words, component name, tag, ARIA attribute or WCAG number (1.4.3, SC 2.1.1, JIS 達成基準, EN 301 549 9.x). Returns for each matching topic: the problem, the fix in one line, how to test it, the guide link, and the criterion in WCAG, EN 301 549, Section 508 and JIS X 8341-3 terms. Topics with no guide yet come back as "in progress". Use it when a finding, a complaint, a failing check or a question names a problem.

limit.description: Topics to return at most (default 8, max 20)

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

query.description: Words, a tag, an ARIA attribute or a WCAG number

name: find_fix
